title: Battle of Czarne
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Czarne", at revision 1370109462, opens: "The Battle of Czarne, 12 to 17 April 1627, took place during the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629) around Czarne in Poland. A Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth army under Stanisław Koniecpolski confronted a Swedish force led by von Lauenstein, Maximilian Teuffel, and von Kötteritz." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q928367, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1627 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
